meta.parties: In Re Estate of Harry Douglas Graham

rules.statement: An application made to the Supreme Court under section 68 of the Courts Ordinance for transferring a testamentary action is considered a testamentary proceeding and should be stamped under Part III of Schedule A of the Stamp Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "Is then, an application of this nature a testamentary proceeding within the meaning of the caption of Part III?"
